experiment: Dense seismic neural-splaut rumble feasibility pass
conclusion: Windowed fitting is tractable and retains harmonic candidates and positive geometry-control evidence. Native event separation/localization accuracy remains unverified; unseen-station power reconstruction is modest. Favorable known-waveform injections are recovered accurately.

mapping.mapping_assumption: Available CSV TrackIndex values refer directly to WAV channels; absent tracks are excluded. This does not verify export ordering.

data.preprocessing: Native 500 Hz; 1 s Hann STFT; 0.1 s hop; recording-wide per-channel/bin 20th percentile floor; one fit-only common scale.
data.heldout_calibration: Validation/test observations estimate their own stationary noise floors only; their transient powers never enter source fitting or initialization.

protocol.selection: Proposals and fit objective score only core arrival frames; padded samples support source-field initialization. Checkpoints use fit objective only. K selected per window by validation mean NMSE; test excluded.
caveats: Available CSV TrackIndex values refer directly to WAV channels; absent tracks are excluded. This does not verify export ordering.
No event identities, clean source recordings or location ground truth.
K and 5 s duration are capacity priors; overlapping windows repeat candidates.
330 m/s fixed speed, stationary point sources and power spreading are propagation assumptions.
Held-out channels estimate their own recording-wide stationary floor only; no held-out transient gain fitting.
Mixture-phase reference masks are candidate components, not proof of clean elephant separation.

spreading_validation.selection: Median validation mean station-balanced NMSE across preselected 28/36/44 s windows and K=1,2; no test-based choice

geometry_controls.selection: Fixed 28/36/44 s windows from visible harmonic contours in fitting channels; no test-based selection
geometry_controls.caveat: One coordinate permutation and one decoder-seed restart per case; sensitivity diagnostic, not a localization confidence interval

injection.description: Two independent overlapping harmonic waveform calls injected into first 16 s of measured seismic background
injection.caveat: Favorable known-count/duration, strong-source, matched-330m/s-and-spreading control; not native elephant ground truth

validation: 46 unit tests passed after propagation and core-window changes; all 58 checkpoints reproduce fit scores within 1e-6; original-rate reference mixture equals components plus residual within 1e-6. Resume retained all 58 complete fits without refitting.
candidate_interpretation: Several harmonic components in the preselected 28-48 s region recur around 45-77 m east and 53-78 m south of M04. This is an unverified candidate region, not an elephant identity or an accuracy estimate. Other inferred components fit non-rumble or station-local energy.
next_experiments: Resolve the CSV/WAV track-count mismatch and independently verify channel ordering.
Model stationary/transient station-local noise separately from propagated calls; investigate geophone gain/coupling and distance attenuation.
Add waveform coherence and harmonic structure to constrain proposals and spatial refinement.
Infer event count/duration and associate repeated estimates across overlapping windows.
Collect field source locations or isolated calls to evaluate actual source-separation and localization accuracy.

refinement.description: Additional budget and capacity diagnostic on three fixed harmonic windows; primary results unchanged
refinement.conclusion: No consistent validation or test improvement. Additional capacity/optimization alone does not resolve native reconstruction.
